plugins.name: arkas
plugins.description: Search, read, capture, organize, and collaboratively edit your Arkas knowledge library.

skills.name: collaborate-on-note
skills.description: Collaborate safely on an Arkas note with comments, suggestions, presence, and revision-aware block edits. Use when reviewing or co-writing a specific note with a person or another agent.

skills.name: connect-arkas
skills.description: Connect and authenticate the Arkas MCP server. Use when Arkas tools are unavailable, disconnected, unauthorized, or need initial setup.

skills.name: curate-library
skills.description: Capture and organize knowledge in Arkas. Use when the user wants to save a link, create or update a note, create a folder, rename an item, or move material within the authorized library scope.

skills.name: research-library
skills.description: Research across an Arkas library or shared folder. Use when the user wants to find, compare, summarize, or synthesize saved notes, links, documents, media transcripts, people, or other library items.
